title: Turn your parking lot into a money machine.
seoTitle: Turn your parking lot into a money machine with VOOL charger.
body:
This is how VOOL Charging system will make you money


1. Install the VOOL Smart EV Charger

Our modular design allows every parking spot to be ready for charging without installing the actual charging module. Click the charging module in place, and you are good to go.

Chargers talk with the outside world through a 4G module integrated into every charger with a globally usable data package.

OCPP 1.6 and 2.0 compatible


2. Set the charging price

First, choose if you want to pay fixed electricity fee or stock price based electricity fee. (We recommend you to use the automated Nord Pool price detection feature.)

Then, set the charging price for others using your chargers.

Our Admin portal gives you full overview and easy cost management access.


3. Make your charger public

Our public charging feature that allows you to share your grid connection - with just a few clicks, any charger in the VOOL system can be made available for public use. Scalable from 1 to thousands of charging points.

4. Earn profit

Different payment solutions are supported for your customers: Stripe, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and credit card. You will get paid in the app. 

And a bonus round: Because your charger is visible on all charge apps you will have more visitors on your site. This is your chance.
